events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the sent welcome copy and the last commit summary
events.input: $ wc -l workshop-plan/sequences/pre.md cloud/src/reminder-copy.ts && cat cloud/src/reminder-copy.ts | head -120 && git show --stat 83a0029 | tail -8

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the top of the pre-workshop sequence copy

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find placeholder names across sequences, ops, worker and probes
events.input: $ grep -rn "centre_link\|calendar_link\|zoom_link\|join_page_url\|join_day1\|centre_url\|calendar_url" --include=*.py --include=*.md --include=*.ts --include=*.mjs workshop-plan/sequences workshop-plan/ops cloud/src cloud/scripts app/scripts 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules | cut -c1-220 | head -60

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find the placeholder map, pre.md structure, and related probes
events.input: $ grep -rn "centre_link\|calendar_link\|zoom_link\|join_page_link\|cohort_list\|join_day1" workshop-plan/sequences/*.py workshop-plan/sequences/campaign-setup.md | cut -c1-240 | head -30; echo ---; grep -n "^# \|^## \|Sent as\|match" workshop-plan/sequences/pre.md | sed -n 1,60p; echo ---; ls workshop-plan/sequences app/scripts | grep -i "nurture\|remind\|pre\|sequence"; grep -n "reminders\|nurture" app/scripts/run-chain.sh | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check where enrolment is wired in the worker
events.input: $ grep -n "welcome_enrolled\|reminder_enrolled\|registered\|enrol" cloud/src/index.ts cloud/src/calendar.ts cloud/src/invites.ts | cut -c1-200 | head -40; echo ---; grep -n "^export\|event\|409\|calendar_url\|centre_url" cloud/src/reminders.ts | cut -c1-200 | head -70

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check reminder run callers, rotation handling and probe coverage
events.input: $ grep -rn "runReminders\|rotat\|revoke" cloud/src --include=*.ts | grep -v "^cloud/src/reminders.ts.*\* " | cut -c1-210 | head -30; echo ---; sed -n 235,262p cloud/src/reminders.ts | cut -c1-260; echo; grep -n "T-228\|rotat\|revok\|welcome\|exactly one\|intake" app/scripts/probe-tantra-reminders.mjs | cut -c1-200 | head -30

events.name: Bash
events.head: List reminder callers, paid confirmation, sign-offs, builder map and running local servers
events.input: $ grep -rn "runReminders" cloud/src | cut -c1-200 | head -20; echo ---; sed -n 203,243p workshop-plan/sequences/pre.md; echo ---; grep -n "Adithya$\|^Adi$" workshop-plan/sequences/pre.md | head -30; echo ---; sed -n 1,40p workshop-plan/sequences/build_nurture.py | cut -c1-230; echo ---; lsof -iTCP -sTCP:LISTEN -P 2>/dev/null | grep -E ":(8787|8792|879[0-9]|4361)" | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check a contact field, probe setup instructions and listening ports
events.input: $ grep -rn "day1_label" cloud/src | grep -v generated | cut -c1-160 | head -5; echo ---; sed -n 1,40p app/scripts/probe-tantra-reminders.mjs | cut -c1-220; echo ---; grep -n "vendor-sim\|wrangler\|8792\|8787\|ADMIN=" app/scripts/run-chain.sh | head -12; grep -n "nurture" app/scripts/run-chain.sh | head -3; lsof -iTCP -sTCP:LISTEN -P 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1,$9}' | sort -u | head -20

events.text: Checking the welcome copy and wiring are consistent on disk; next I run the reminders probe against the local simulator and add a drift check between pre.md and the sent email.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check the local centre and simulator are up
events.input: $ for p in 8790 8792; do curl -s -o /dev/null -m 4 -w "$p %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:$p/; done; test -s /tmp/rc-local-admin-url && echo admin-url-present; git status --short cloud/src | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run the reminders probe against the local centre and simulator
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app && ADMIN=$(cat /tmp/rc-local-admin-url) && CENTRE="${ADMIN%%/admin/*}" SIM=http://127.0.0.1:8792 ADMIN_KEY="${ADMIN##*k=}" node scripts/probe-tantra-reminders.mjs > /tmp/t228-probe.log 2>&1; echo "exit $?"; grep -c "^PASS" /tmp/t228-probe.log; grep "^FAIL" /tmp/t228-probe.log | head; grep -i "calendar\|centre link\|Registered" /tmp/t228-probe.log | cut -c1-200 | head -14; tail -2 /tmp/t228-probe.log | cut -c1-200

events.name: Bash
events.head: Diagnose why the probe's admin session failed, without printing key values
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign && head -c 600 /tmp/t228-probe.log | sed -E 's/k=[A-Za-z0-9_-]+/k=***/g'; echo; sed -n 40,60p app/scripts/probe-tantra-reminders.mjs | cut -c1-230; sed -E 's/k=.*/k=***/' /tmp/rc-local-admin-url; test -f cloud/.dev.vars && grep -c "^ADMIN_KEY=" cloud/.dev.vars; A=$(cat /tmp/rc-local-admin-url); K1="${A##*k=}"; K2=$(grep "^ADMIN_KEY=" cloud/.dev.vars 2>/dev/null | cut -d= -f2- | tr -d '"'); [ "$K1" = "$K2" ] && echo same-key || echo different-key

events.name: Bash
events.head: Re-run the reminders probe using the local dev admin key
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app && CENTRE=http://127.0.0.1:8790 SIM=http://127.0.0.1:8792 node scripts/probe-tantra-reminders.mjs > /tmp/t228-probe.log 2>&1; echo "exit $?"; grep -c "^PASS" /tmp/t228-probe.log; grep "^FAIL" /tmp/t228-probe.log | cut -c1-220 | head; grep -i "calendar\|Registered" /tmp/t228-probe.log | cut -c1-210 | head -14; tail -2 /tmp/t228-probe.log | cut -c1-200
